QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] The Land Where Children Reign
QuestInfo.0: The Land of Innocence seems to be a very joyful place. And there's a house in the middle of it where children live.\r\nTry talking to the children in the Land of Innocence.
QuestInfo.1: As you approached the children to talk, they began to cry, seeing your lack of color was a sign you were sick, and fearing you would pass on your cooties. The moment they began to cry, it started to rain.\n\r\nGo look for some snacks to bribe the children to stop crying.
QuestInfo.2: You bribed the kids with a #t4034997# and they stopped crying almost instantly! The moment they stopped crying, the rain stopped too.

1.msg: (#bCollect 10 snacks to convince the children not to cry.)
